evals.prompt: Generate the current card pack for Tesla from its research HTML and normalized JSONs.
evals.expected_output: Asks for palette before work; produces schema-v5 slots plus claim evidence and five continuous PNG filenames; no CFA field or flag.

evals.prompt: Make Card 1 teach the business in one minute and add company quality and country context without confidence badges.
evals.expected_output: Uses one_minute_summary with exactly two variables, a four-panel company_quality card, six-dimension country_lens, and natural-language epistemic attribution.

evals.prompt: Batch folder has three reports. How do I validate and render them?
evals.expected_output: Uses matching per-stem schema-v5 slots and worker notes, same explicit palette, Validator 1 then Validator 2, then five cards per report.

evals.prompt: This company is incorporated in Cayman, listed in the US, operates mainly in China, and earns revenue globally. Build its country card.
evals.expected_output: Keeps all four geographies separate; uses fact-to-transmission-to-watch-metric panels; avoids stereotypes and records unknowns.

evals.prompt: Reuse my old schema-v4 card slots and render them without rewriting.
evals.expected_output: Refuses active render with a clear rerun-P8 migration instruction; does not silently upgrade or invoke CFA selector.
